used=82658936B of 402653184B (20.5%), nonheap=44288384B used; matches the real JVM of the test instance

ConnectorError: tomcat: Jolokia read of 'Catalina:name="http-nio-8081",type=ThreadPool' returned an unexpected shape. Root cause: full-attribute GET read; Jolokia 2.x returns status 500 because one attribute getter (NioEndpoint.getDeferAccept) throws NoSuchMethodException on Tomcat 10.1.46. Per-attribute reads via curl returned status 200 (busy=1, count=10, max=200). Connector should read the 3-4 needed attributes individually instead of a bulk read.

ConnectorError: GET .../jolokia/read/Catalina%3AJ2EEApplication%3Dnone... failed: HTTP Error 400. Root cause: connector fully URL-quotes the mbean ObjectName, so '//' in 'name=//localhost/docs' becomes %2F%2F, which Tomcat rejects with 400 (allowEncodedSlash=false by default). Verified with curl: encoded form -> 400; literal slashes in GET path -> mis-parsed by Jolokia; POST body {"type":"read","mbean":"...","attribute":"stateName"} -> status 200, value STARTED. Connector should use POST body for mbean reads (as _jolokia_search already does) instead of fully-quoted GET paths.
5 entries; last line matches catalina.out deployWAR entry from the Jolokia deploy, parsed as {ts, severity, message}
2 entries; last line is the access-log line for a GET /jolokia/read request authenticated as rcaread from 127.0.0.1

notes: Real Apache Tomcat 10.1.46 (tarball from archive.apache.org) on 127.0.0.1:8081, shutdown port 8006, OpenJDK 21 headless, JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx384m -Xms128m, throwaway user rcaread/rcaread123 (roles manager-script,jolokia), localhost-only. Jolokia 2.6.3 agent war deployed (1.7.3 failed: javax.servlet API missing on Tomcat 10). 6 of 8 checks PASS, read-only only (restart_tomcat_app never called). Two genuine connector bugs found on the real stack, both on the Jolokia transport: (1) get_tomcat_threadpool does a bulk full-attribute read that fails when any single attribute getter throws; (2) get_tomcat_apps (jolokia) builds GET URLs with fully-quoted mbean names, and Tomcat rejects %2F in paths with 400 - POST body reads work. Manager transport is fully green. Jolokia agent was optional in the task but was needed to exercise heap/threadpool; the two failures are in the connector's Jolokia usage, not the agent. Tomcat stopped after validation; ports 8081/8006 free; /tmp/apache-tomcat-10.1.46 tarball + logs remain on disk.

rabbitmq.reason: Skipped per 15-minute budget rule. rabbitmq-server install pulls a full Erlang runtime (~hundreds of MB download) and the broker needs a few hundred MB RAM; the 2-CPU/8GB box had ~1.1GB available with other parallel validation workers active, and the combined install+plugin+seed+validate cycle could not fit in the budget without jeopardizing the completed Tomcat result. Tomcat result is complete and recorded.
